 assert sha(record['admission_snapshot'].encode())==record['source_and_input_hashes']['proofs/informal/'+note]

assert sha(v['source_snapshots']['proofs/informal/problem1_terminal_branch_sensitivity.md'].encode())==v['worker_corrected_record']['input_sha256']['proofs/informal/problem1_terminal_branch_sensitivity.md']
for name,snapshot in review['note_snapshots_at_lead_audit'].items():assert sha(snapshot.encode())==review['source_and_input_hashes'][name]
